purpose: Independent same-input CPU reproduction of rough OBrush0.1.2 Draw strokes and local quality checks for0.1.3; no reconstruction of the user screenshot, no ZBrush comparison

user_report.scenario: Draw on a fresh sphere; defaults radius0.180,strength35%; Xsymmetry shown enabled

fixture_origin: Independently generated unit-radius Mesh::sphere(level); initial OBJ vertex/face record hashes match across stages, while normal records differ by implementation

metrics.angles: Angles between neighboring geometric unit face normals, not interpolated shading normals; unique shared-edge counters strictly above30/60/90degrees
metrics.roughness: Absolute normal projection of vertex minus one-ring neighbor mean, divided by mean neighbor-edge length; p95 on edited/appended vertices. Curvature proxy, not a general artifact or intersection detector.
metrics.edge_scale: Actual final edge lengths and normalization by initial sphere median; original_vertex_edge_max_stretch only uses edges whose endpoints existed initially
metrics.height: Maximum radial height relative to initial sphere; original vertices use original radius, appended vertices use unit-radius baseline
metrics.per_dab_reversals: Each pre-dab face cross product compared to its cross product using retained original vertex indices after the dab; linear refinement preserves those indices. New child winding is covered separately by core refinement tests.
metrics.probe_timing: Includes per-dab external snapshots/full f64 diagnostic scans; excludes final metric scans,exports,renderer/UI; not application latency

gate_provenance: Local thresholds selected after inspecting baseline/candidate output, before this final source run. Not preregistered ZBrush-quality tolerances or universal mesh guarantees.
limitations: No global triangle self-intersection proof or automatic repair of pre-damaged imported meshes
Bounded adaptive edge refinement, not decimation, remeshing, persistent multiresolution or Sculptris Pro parity
These12 fixed input paths are not exhaustive of topology,pressure,speed,brushes or cameras
About30ms native CPU cost per dab remains an interaction-performance limitation; interactive host performance not established by these probes
Visual/runtime/build evidence is recorded separately in draw-visual-comparison.json,draw-browser-runtime.json,draw-quality-build.json
